correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently generated Petersen Kneser graph and its 332 matching faces, f=(15,75,145,90,6), distinct from the 1-dimensional graph realization M(K5). Full finite acyclic greedy discrete Morse checking found 158 matched pairs on 331 nonempty faces and topologically visited all 975 Hasse incidences, leaving cells {0:1,2:7,3:7}. Independent exact signed Morse boundary on seven 3-cells and seven 2-cells reproduced the printed 7×7 matrix and has exactly two primitive unit factors and rank two; with simply connected 2-skeleton, π2=H2 gives all 3-cell attaching maps, so integral CW reductions yield 5 S2 and 5 S3, not merely Betti ranks. Independently computed modular chain and boundary-image traces for all 120 S5 permutations, checking χ2=sgn(g)*f1(g), χ3=f2(g)-f1(g); finite modulus 1000003 exceeds twice any possible chain trace so integer lifts are unambiguous. Splitting into sign-twisted permutation five module and irreducible Specht(3,2) follows standard permutation-character decomposition.
